scope.summary: Removed the shader-based post-tonemap Graphics.Blit from authoritative native-4K still capture and replaced it with an explicit in-place fixed-function MSAA resolve on the canonical camera RenderTexture. Added fail-closed source/runtime QA and a machine-readable contract so formal evidence cannot silently reintroduce a shader copy or raw multisample binding.
scope.whyThisWasPrioritized: The previous capture path rendered the approved filmic output into an sRGB MSAA target, then sampled it through Graphics.Blit into a second LDR target. Unity documents Graphics.Blit as a shader copy and sRGB writes as color-state-sensitive. Even with identical scene assets, this extra stage could alter fine edges, gradients or encoded display values. Evidence-path fidelity is therefore a prerequisite for trustworthy Texture/Microdetail and Cinematic scoring.

changes.effect: Formal QA4K targets now explicitly use bindMS=false, call ResolveAntiAliasedSurface() in-place when MSAA>1, read pixels directly from that canonical target, and no longer allocate/use a second resolved RenderTexture or Graphics.Blit. Runtime manifest schema is 1.2 and discloses the fixed-function/no-post-tonemap-blit path.

New fail-closed gate verifies the canonical capture source retains bindMS=false, fixed-function resolve, direct readback and no Graphics.Blit call; Camera.onPreCull rejects QA4K targets with bindTextureMS=true or mipmaps.
Machine-readable zero-point contract records resolve/readback requirements, risk mapping, required failure injections and real-render evidence requirements.

staticRepositoryVerification: Start HEAD to pre-record HEAD compares ahead 4 / behind 0 with merge-base equal to the start HEAD.
Diff is confined to UnityProject/Assets/Editor and UnityProject/Assets/QA; no Godot path changed.
Canonical capture source now contains bindMS=false and ResolveAntiAliasedSurface(), reads from msaaTarget, and has no executable Graphics.Blit call.
Formal manifest continues to identify Unity Camera.Render and remains UNSCORED_REVIEW_REQUIRED.

expectedVisualScoreImpactNotAwarded.Material/PBR physical plausibility: small-medium evidence integrity improvement: grazing highlights and roughness response are reviewed from the camera's resolved output rather than a second shader copy.
expectedVisualScoreImpactNotAwarded.Temporal/LOD/aliasing stability: medium evidence integrity improvement: still-reference edge behavior is less confounded by a separate post-tonemap blit path.
